commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Miguel Ortiz has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' A short pass finds Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90+3' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) replaces Viktor Tsygankov.
89' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad).
89' Arnau Martinez (Girona) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Miguel Ortiz blows for a foul.
86' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

86' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Real Sociedad will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
84' Here comes a substitution. Sergio Gomez is given a rest as he is replaced by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
84' 1 - 2 GOAL! Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) finishes off a sublime move with a delightful back-heel goal. Alex Moreno provided the assist with a brilliant pass. 1:2.
81' A cross from Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
79' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) argues strongly with the referee and is awarded a yellow card. A needless yellow card!
78' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Girona players have a reason to celebrate!
77' Wait! Referee Miguel Ortiz has indicated he is going to review the Girona goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Brais Mendez.
77' Michel prepares a substitution. Bryan Gil is replaced by Yaser Asprilla (Girona).

76' 1 - 1 Azzedine Ounahi sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot inside the right post. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 1:1.
74' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Miguel Ortiz and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
73' Bryan Gil (Girona) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
73' Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
70' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) and Thomas Lemar try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
69' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
67' Thomas Lemar (Girona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
66' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
64' Substitution. Goncalo Guedes will be replaced by Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad).
64' Substitution. Thomas Lemar (Girona) on for Ivan Martin.
64' Sergio Francisco has decided to make a change. Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) replaces Carlos Soler.
61' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
60' Bryan Gil (Girona) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.
60' Arnau Martinez (Girona) flashes a in volley from just outside the box, but it goes well wide of the left post. The goalkeeper can stay calm.
59' Alex Moreno (Girona) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
58' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
57' A wild effort from Bryan Gil (Girona) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
52' Alex Moreno (Girona) sends a cross into the box, but Alex Remiro comes off his line to gather the ball.
50' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
48' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) and Sergio Gomez try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) is replaced by Jon Karrikaburu.
46' Michel has made a change at the break. Joel Roca has come on in place of Vladyslav Vanat (Girona).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
43' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Real Sociedad have a corner.
42' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Girona.
41' Axel Witsel (Girona) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety. Girona get a corner.
40' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) is caught offside!
39' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.

35' 1 - 0 Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Paulo Gazzaniga is just a bystander as the ball flies into the right side of the goal. The score is 1:0.
33' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
32' Bryan Gil (Girona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
31' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
30' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Real Sociedad have a corner.
30' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) attempts to find Alex Moreno with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
29' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
28' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
27' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) attempts to release Bryan Gil with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
25' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) and Jon Gorrotxategi try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
25' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
24' Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
23' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
23' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Real Sociedad will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
21' Jon Aramburu (Real Sociedad) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
20' Azzedine Ounahi (Girona) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
19' Vitor Reis (Girona) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.

19' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) has a good chance to score with a mid-range attempt after collecting a pass. He aims for the bottom left corner, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Alex Remiro. Girona have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
13' Vladyslav Vanat loses the ball after receiving a sweet pass from Viktor Tsygankov (Girona).
12' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Sergio Gomez.

9' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
6' Bryan Gil (Girona) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
4' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) connects with an accurate pass inside the box and fires the ball to the bottom right corner, but one of the defending players steps in to block the effort.
4' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range low towards the middle of the goal, but Paulo Gazzaniga is equal to it and makes an easy save.
3' Vladyslav Vanat (Girona) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
2' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Real Sociedad will have the kick-off.
Miguel Ortiz was nominated as the referee for this game.
